# A scarecrow keeping watch at the back of the bed: a post, outstretched arms, a straw head under a
# wide dark hat, a rust shirt. Up Z, facing -Y.
new
add mesh cube --name Post --size 1 --location 0 0 0.8
scale 0.1 0.1 1.6
apply --scale
material new Wood --base-color 0.467 0.361 0.310
material assign Wood
add mesh cube --name Shirt --size 1 --location 0 0 1.15
scale 0.42 0.24 0.5
apply --scale
add mesh cube --name Arms --size 1 --location 0 0 1.3
scale 1.2 0.12 0.14
apply --scale
material new Shirt --base-color 0.376 0.231 0.227
select Shirt Arms
material assign Shirt
add mesh ico-sphere --name Head --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.18 --location 0 0 1.6
add mesh cube --name HandL --size 1 --location -0.66 0 1.3
scale 0.12 0.14 0.14
apply --scale
add mesh cube --name HandR --size 1 --location 0.66 0 1.3
scale 0.12 0.14 0.14
apply --scale
material new Straw --base-color 0.631 0.624 0.486
select Head HandL HandR
material assign Straw
add mesh cylinder --name Brim --vertices 8 --radius 0.34 --depth 0.05 --location 0 0 1.74
add mesh cone --name Crown --vertices 8 --radius1 0.18 --radius2 0.1 --depth 0.24 --location 0 0 1.88
material new Hat --base-color 0.184 0.129 0.231
select Brim Crown
material assign Hat
select all
shade flat
export scarecrow.glb
